name: Bebuzee Inc.
summary: Bebuzee Inc. manages a digital platform encompassing both video sharing and a dedicated streaming service. This service grants its subscribers access to a wide array of content, including movies, television series, documentaries, and discussion programs, accessible across various internet-enabled devices. Beyond its core entertainment offerings, the platform also delivers real-time news updates, thought-provoking blog posts, and a diverse collection of videos and images. The company, which began its operations in 2011, rebranded from its former name, Engage Mobility, Inc., to Bebuzee Inc. in May 2023 and is based in Miami, Florida.
